review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that advertising yield notable economic advantages, whereas some individuals contend that it leads to dissatisfaction caused by fostering personal discontentment among these people. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Some might argue that advertising bring undeniable economic benefits. Its creative content and appealing visual effects stimulate consumer demand and spending power. The rise in consumption encourage higher production levels, which subsequently lead to expanded job opportunities in sectors such as marketing, media and design. Furthermore, this sharply generates greater state revenue through taxation. For example, e-commerce platforms like Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector.

Others claim that advertising can have negative social impacts by constantly presenting ideal lifestyles, unrealistic beauty standards and luxury possessions, which can foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular often feel pressure to purchase trendy clothes or the latest smartphones after seeing advertisements on TikTok or Facebook. This can lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. Furthermore, more advertising can encourage materialistic values because people may start to believe that having more expensive items means having a better life. In the long run, this may create a more money-driven society.
Overall, I believe that both views valid to some certain extents. Advertising contributes to social dissatisfaction, but play a crucial role in economic development.

Phần phát triển ý có nhiều điểm tốt: Body 1 nối được quảng cáo với nhu cầu, sản xuất, việc làm và thuế; Body 2 nối được hình ảnh lý tưởng với áp lực mua sắm và chủ nghĩa vật chất. Tuy nhiên, bài còn nhiều lỗi hòa hợp chủ ngữ–động từ và cách mượn lời quá chung như “Some might argue” và “Others claim”. Em cần viết lại toàn bài, gọi rõ hai phe và rà từng động từ trước khi nộp.

paragraphs: Advertising may bring economic advantages, whereas it can also leave people dissatisfied with their lives. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. Increased spending encourages producers to raise output, which creates employment opportunities and tax revenue. For example, Shopee and Lazada use campaigns to attract customers and expand digital retail. Furthermore, advertising provides direct work in marketing, media and design. This wider spending can also support suppliers, transport services and public finances. The example therefore shows how advertising affects more than one company.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Ideal lifestyles, unrealistic beauty standards and luxury possessions may foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people may feel pressure to purchase trendy clothes or the latest phones promoted on TikTok and Facebook. When they cannot afford these items, they may experience frustration. Repeated pressure may then strengthen materialistic values and create a money-driven society. For this reason, viewers may judge their own possessions against an unrealistic standard. The social cost can remain after a campaign has ended.
In conclusion, advertising can promote demand, employment and state revenue. At the same time, it may cause dissatisfaction and encourage materialistic values.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
